conflicts_found: Naming: FTG's own page calls the product 'Dream League Soccer' (no year), the App Store slug is 'dream-league-soccer-2020' with id 1462911602, and the Play listing is titled 'Dream League Soccer 2026'. Franchise-continuity rule (PROMPT.md preamble) applies: same package id, so this is one continuously-updated product, not a new release — to be verified against store listings, not assumed.
Package id 'com.firsttouchgames.dls7' vs a title of '2026' — the internal name has not been renumbered with the marketing year. Relevant to Step 2 APK targeting.
entries.confidence_note: Official first-party source for the fact that FTG publishes DLS and for its store identities. Single source; no corroboration yet; marketing figures Speculative until checked against the game or a database.
